cohort: 208 full-term neonates aged 24 hours to 7 days admitted to a postnatal ward of a tertiary care hospital who were directly breastfed.
finding: Objective assessment tools revealed that a majority of infants were well-supported and latched effectively, with most dyads achieving high scores on breastfeeding assessments.
mod_finding: Cesarean-delivered and primiparous mothers required more focused breastfeeding counseling and support.
